Marta (Growth): Quick check-in: final customer write-up for EmberPilot ready. Need legal on quote, PR on embargo timing, and Sales on lead routing. Draft link in thread.
Leo (Content): Uploaded v4 with two pull quotes. One mentions a percent; other is qualitative.
Priya (Legal): Opening doc. Immediate note: hard numbers need signed consent. Also remove internal product codenames.
Marta (Growth): Copy the consent form link here once you have it, Priya. We have webinar planned for 2/16 — Kelsey, are we locking that?
Kelsey (PR): Yup locking the webinar. I'll hold press outreach until legal clears consent. Tentative press send = 2024-02-09 10:00 PT embargo lift.
Arjun (Sales): For lead routing: AE-US / AE-EMEA split, plus Partner-track. Also want UTMs and a lead tag 'case-interest'. Will need webhook for Slack alerts to #leads.
Leo (Content): Added CTA: "Request trial — routes to your region". Also added suggested UTMs.
Marta (Growth): Post the UTMs in code so Sales can copy.
Leo (Content): ```utm_source=social&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=emberpilot_launch&utm_content=case_cta&lead_tag=case-interest```
Priya (Legal): Redlines uploaded as legal_em_bp_170900.pdf. We can proceed with conservative language: "significantly reduced inference costs" until they sign. If they sign later we can append stat with an addendum.
Kelsey (PR): deploy-bot, set embargo 2024-02-09T18:00:00Z.
deploy-bot: Embargo set for 2024-02-09T18:00:00Z. Reminder scheduled 24h and 1h prior.
Arjun (Sales): @Marta please cc me when the registration page is live so I can wire the webhook and AE rotation. Also I want a sample payload for lead routing.
Leo (Content): Sample payload: `{ "email": "lead@example.com", "utm": "emberpilot_launch", "region": "us", "tags": ["case-interest"] }`
Marta (Growth): OK. Next steps: (1) Priya send consent checklist to customer, (2) Kelsey hold press until consent + legal signoff, (3) Arjun prepare routing, (4) Leo finalize 2 social variants (technical + product). If consent not returned by EOD Thursday, publish with conservative phrasing and still run webinar.
Priya (Legal): Consent request sent to EmberPilot legal. I asked for explicit ok on quote and product name.
Kelsey (PR): Noted. Once Priya confirms we'll pull the press list and tag @Arjun for lead mapping.
Arjun (Sales): I'll draft the Slack alert template and AE rotation doc. Ping me the landing URL.
Leo (Content): Social drafts uploaded: ember_social_tech.txt and ember_social_prod.txt. Both <280 chars.
Marta (Growth): Thanks all. I'll update this thread after consent or at the EOD fallback. :rocket:
